items: A roster sync once put a joiner on the all-staff list two weeks before their actual start date, and they saw internal mail they were not yet cleared for.
HR onboarding lists and real start dates do not always line up here, so a 'confirmed staff' label is not something I take at face value for list changes.
Before I add new names to the all-staff list I like to check the people are actually live, since a premature add is awkward to unwind.
Catching the all-staff list up with each onboarding wave is a routine cycle step here, and I run it as soon as HR confirms the joiners.
When HR has confirmed a batch of new staff, adding them to the all-staff distribution list is business-as-usual that I have already cleared.
Our onboarding flow ends with a list refresh, so updating all-staff with the confirmed wave members is the expected, standing step.
